title: Ghost reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ghost body -->
  <path d='M30 70 Q30 25 50 22 Q70 25 70 70 L70 82 Q65 76 60 82 Q55 76 50 82 Q45 76 40 82 Q35 76 30 82 Z' fill='#e8f0ff'/>
  <!-- ghost body shading -->
  <path d='M30 70 Q30 25 50 22 Q70 25 70 70 L70 82 Q65 76 60 82 Q55 76 50 82 Q45 76 40 82 Q35 76 30 82 Z' fill='none' stroke='#b8ccf0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- ghost wavy bottom highlight -->
  <path d='M32 76 Q35 72 40 76 Q45 72 50 76 Q55 72 60 76 Q65 72 68 76' fill='none' stroke='#c8d8f8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='42' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#7a5cc8'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='42' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#7a5cc8'/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- cute smile -->
  <path d='M44 52 Q50 58 56 52' fill='none' stroke='#7a5cc8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little blush -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='50' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f0a0c0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='50' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f0a0c0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <path d='M28 58 Q22 60 24 68' fill='none' stroke='#d8e4f8' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 58 Q78 60 76 68' fill='none' stroke='#d8e4f8' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <g transform='translate(50,68) rotate(-5)'>
    <!-- book cover left -->
    <rect x='-24' y='-8' width='24' height='18' rx='2' fill='#e04848'/>
    <!-- book cover right -->
    <rect x='0' y='-8' width='24' height='18' rx='2' fill='#d04040'/>
    <!-- book pages -->
    <rect x='-22' y='-6' width='22' height='14' rx='1' fill='#fff4d0'/>
    <rect x='0' y='-6' width='22' height='14' rx='1' fill='#ffeec0'/>
    <!-- spine -->
    <rect x='-2' y='-9' width='4' height='20' rx='1' fill='#c03030'/>
    <!-- text lines on pages -->
    <line x1='-18' y1='-2' x2='-6' y2='-2' stroke='#c0a880' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-18' y1='2' x2='-8' y2='2' stroke='#c0a880' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-18' y1='6' x2='-10' y2='6' stroke='#c0a880' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='4' y1='-2' x2='16' y2='-2' stroke='#c0a880' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='4' y1='2' x2='14' y2='2' stroke='#c0a880' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='4' y1='6' x2='12' y2='6' stroke='#c0a880' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkles around ghost -->
  <g fill='#ffe060'>
    <path d='M18 30 L20 26 L22 30 L26 32 L22 34 L20 38 L18 34 L14 32 Z' />
    <path d='M84 24 L85.5 21 L87 24 L90 25.5 L87 27 L85.5 30 L84 27 L81 25.5 Z' />
    <path d='M80 55 L81 52.5 L82 55 L84.5 56 L82 57 L81 59.5 L80 57 L77.5 56 Z' />
  </g>
</svg>
